classification: read-only inventory; source assets and production manifests unchanged

methods.measurements: Per-frame visible alpha bounds aggregated to medians, ranges, bottom anchors, edge and blank-frame counts.

findings.runtime_direction_coverage: Eight logical directions are selected; only five independent source sheets load and west/northwest/southwest are mirrored.
findings.action_facing: The action event carries aim direction, but HeroView.play_action receives only an action name; actor pose/facing remains whatever movement last set.
findings.hit_reaction: No dedicated hurt animation; damage is communicated by flash, shake, text and procedural particles.
findings.hero_specific_vfx_assets: No gameplay VFX sprite sequence is loaded for player attacks; swing/rings/projectiles/zones/impacts are drawn procedurally and recolored with visual themes.
findings.historical_audit: The existing prompt audit covers 90 older-contract records and labels review status unreviewed; it does not resolve the newly approved eight-source contract.
